title: Highway to help
situation: You are {{Kara}}. It is one in the morning on November 7th, and snow is falling hard. You are on the road in {{Zlatko}}’s car with {{Alice}} and {{Luther}}, the big android who turned against {{Zlatko}} and helped you escape his house. You are heading for the people {{Luther}} says help androids cross the border.
facts: You, {{Alice}} and {{Luther}} left {{Zlatko}}’s house in his car in the night of November 7th, heading for people {{Luther}} says help androids cross the border.

outcomes.0: The car drives on through the snow.

adaptationNote: The chart’s checkpoint HIGHWAY TO HELP, narrated as an event. The date and time are the template’s (NOV 7TH, 2038, AM 01:02), given without the year. {{Luther}} turning on {{Zlatko}} and coming with {{Kara}} is the only way into this chapter (the Zlatko chapter’s one surviving ending, LUTHER JOINS KARA & ALICE); the destination is {{Kara}}’s own line in the car (“These people we’re going to see…”). The scene does not read or set any state. No stat change.

title: In the car
situation: You are {{Kara}}, in {{Zlatko}}’s car, driving through the snow at night. {{Luther}} sits to your left; {{Alice}} is on the back seat. The board computer on the dashboard has a TV screen. You can do one thing at a time, or simply let the drive go on.

situationWhen.text: The TV on the dashboard is on.

options.text: Switch on the TV on the dashboard and watch the news.
options.fact: The car TV news: police say the AX400 android that attacked its owner in a {{Detroit}} suburb is still at large, and its description has been shared with all local law enforcement; the submarine USS IOWA has disappeared in the Arctic and President {{Warren}} has called a crisis meeting; the heavy snow will go on until Monday evening, at 22°, far below seasonal averages.
options.outcome: {{Kara}} switches on the board computer’s TV and goes through the channels. Channel 16: “…the AX400 android reported to have attacked its owner in a {{Detroit}} suburb is still at large. Police appeared to lose its trail after a close {{Encounter}} with investigators. The android’s description has been shared with all local law enforcement and the investigation is ongoing…” CTN: “The Arctic conflict has escalated to new heights this morning. We have just learned that the USS IOWA, a destroyer-class submarine patrolling in the region, is reported to have disappeared after surfacing for repairs. President {{Warren}} immediately called for a crisis meeting of high-ranking officers in the White House. With the world on the brink of war, this incident could well be the spark that lights the fuse.” KNC: “… {{Detroit}}’s heavy snowfall is expected to continue throughout the night. The forecast is 22°, far below seasonal averages. And this cold front is likely to persist over the coming days, up until Monday evening.”

options.text: Change the channel once more.
options.fact: The car TV news reported a house fire on the outskirts of the city: a body found in the wreckage is unidentified, and dozens of androids were found in the ruins.
options.outcome: Channel 16 again: “…meanwhile fire crews have been battling a house fire on the outskirts of the city. The blaze is now under control, but a body found in the wreckage remains unidentified. Dozens of androids were also found in the ruins, though their presence remains a mystery…”

options.text: CAR: say it is a good thing {{Zlatko}} had a car.
options.outcome: “It’s a good thing {{Zlatko}} had a car… I wouldn’t want {{Alice}} out walking in this cold…” {{Luther}}: “I saw it once in the garage. I don’t know if {{Zlatko}} even ever used it.”

options.text: DESTINATION: ask {{Luther}} how he knows about the people you are going to see.
options.fact: {{Luther}} heard about the humans who help androids cross the border from androids {{Zlatko}} had captured. They believed it, until {{Zlatko}} killed them.
options.outcome: “These people we’re going to see... How do you know about them?” {{Luther}}: “Overheard androids {{Zlatko}} captured. They said they were humans helping androids to cross the border… All I know is those androids believed it.” {{Kara}}: “What if it was a lie?.. Or just another trap?” {{Luther}}: “All I know is those androids believed it. Until {{Zlatko}} killed them.”

options.text: DISTANCE: ask whether it is much farther.
options.outcome: “Is it much farther?” {{Luther}}: “We should arrive in an hour or so.”

options.text: WEATHER: say you have never seen snow before.
options.outcome: “I’ve never seen snow before… It’s pretty…” {{Luther}}: “It’s slowing us down... But at least we won’t meet any humans along the way…”

options.text: Turn around and look at {{Alice}} on the back seat.
options.outcome: {{Kara}} turns and looks at {{Alice}} on the back seat.

options.text: Let the drive go on.
options.outcome: The car drives on into the night.

adaptationNote: The chart’s [ CAR ] block: WATCH NEWS, TALK TO LUTHER and LOOK AT ALICE, all optional, before CAR BREAKS DOWN, which the game plays after a short drive whatever {{Kara}} does (PowerPyx: “No way to miss this”). WATCH NEWS is the board computer’s TV (the template’s unlock type TV; PowerPyx: “the TV program at the board computer”); its three ordinary channels are one option, in the template’s order, and changing the channel once more brings the fourth report, the house fire, which exists only if {{Kara}} set {{Zlatko}}’s house on fire (the built-in `fire` flag from the Zlatko chapter, read as is). Public opinion: the template has one arrow in the chapter, small down on the fire report (condition “Kara set the house on fire in Zlatko”; the Public_Opinion page: “Changing the radio channel at least 4 different times … Only if Kara set fire to Zlatko’s mansion”), and that is the only change built. The wiki’s chapter page and Public_Opinion page also list a small down for turning the news on; the template has no arrow there and wins for arrows (research note, section 10.3), so it is not applied. TALK TO LUTHER is the template’s PROMPT 1 with the game’s four buttons CAR, DESTINATION, DISTANCE and WEATHER, in the template’s order, and the spoken lines; each topic can be raised once (the sources do not say whether the game allows more than one). LOOK AT ALICE has no line or effect in any source and is narrated as a look. The exit “let the drive go on” is the benchmark’s way to end the free choice; in the game the breakdown ends it after a short drive. Built as 8 copies of one scene (K14b1 to K14b8) sharing the hub state `ch21Car`: each copy offers only what has not been done yet, and once “let the drive go on” is chosen the remaining copies are skipped. There are as many copies as options, so every option stays reachable. (A single repeatable scene would do the same, but tests/story.test.mjs lets only its four listed scenes repeat.)

title: The magazine on the barrels
situation: You are {{Kara}}, inside the tavern. On the barrels where you put down your flashlight lies a magazine with two covers.

media.title: {{Detroit}} Today: USS Iowa Missing
facts: {{Detroit}} Today: the destroyer-class submarine USS IOWA has disappeared in polar waters, last seen in the Arctic Sea. President {{Warren}} suspects the Russians: “Russian aggression just reached a new level. America must respond.” The Kremlin has issued a blanket denial, a Russian diplomat said “A US destroyer-class submarine has no business being in the Arctic anyway”, and a security expert called the situation “a war waiting to start.” An ad on the cover: “{{Canada}}: where the air is clean and the welcome is always warm.”

media.title: Gossips Weekly: All-Android Band Tipped for Music Prize
facts: Gossips Weekly: the latest all-android boy band, from a {{Detroit}} record label, is tipped to win Best New Artist at the Celebrate Music Awards. Human-only labels protest at the “erosion of artistic merit in music”, but with less than 5% of the music market now produced by human musicians, the traditionalists are not being heard. Cover lines: “Is President {{Warren}} too close to {{CyberLife}}?” and “Cyber security expert warns: your android could be hacked”.

adaptationNote: The chart’s two optional nodes READ “USS IOWA” and READ “ALL-ANDROID BAND” in [ THE TAVERN ]: one magazine with two covers, on the barrels where {{Kara}} puts her flashlight, “right in front of you” when the player regains control (PowerPyx), so it comes first here.
